Domino's and Indian Overseas Bank Beat Expectations Amid Supply Chain Strength

Domino's Pizza and Indian Overseas Bank have reported better-than-expected financial results, with Domino's beating revenue estimates due to its strong supply chain business and IOB seeing a significant increase in net profit driven by higher recoveries and core income. These positive earnings reports suggest that the companies are performing well despite potential challenges in the industry.
